Checklist.Title: Pre-update checklist
Checklist.Backup: Back up this world (Setup > Worlds > Create Backup, or copy the world folder).
Checklist.UserData: Back up the whole user data folder, including modules and systems.
Checklist.ReleaseNotes: Read the release notes for the new core version and for your game system.
Checklist.Export: Export this report so you know what was enabled before.
Checklist.UpdateModules: Update modules that have a newer version supporting the target.
Checklist.DisableRisky: Disable modules marked Likely to break or Blocked (button below).
Checklist.TestCopy: Try the update on a copy of the world first.
Checklist.Installer: Keep the installer for your current version in case you need to roll back.

Disable.Title: Disable risky modules?
Disable.Intro: These active modules are Likely to break or Blocked on core {t}. Untick any you want to keep. Nothing changes until you confirm.
Disable.Snapshot: Your current module list is saved first, so you can restore it later.
Disable.SnapshotLabel: Before disabling risky modules for core {t}
Disable.Done: Disabled {n} module(s). A snapshot of the previous list was saved.
